name: Heavenly Presence
body:
Your unearthly presence becomes more powerful.

Prerequisite: Muse, Character Level 7.

Benefit: You gain the benefit of the unearthly presence racial trait regardless of your hit point total.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
